confirm.description: Do you want to set up a Rinnai Touch Wifi?

user.title: Connect to Rinnai Touch
user.description: Enter the bridge address. Installed zones and MTSP/SSP topology are detected automatically.

rinnai_set_time.name: Set controller time
rinnai_set_time.description: Sets the day and time on the Rinnai controller.

set_datetime.name: Date and time
set_datetime.description: Date and time to send, or the current Home Assistant time when omitted.

set_schedule_period.name: Set schedule period
set_schedule_period.description: Programs one period in the active heating or add-on cooling schedule. Target the main climate entity on a single-set-point system or a zone climate entity on an MTSP system.

day.name: Day
day.description: Select the day option matching the controller's configured grouping.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: Time at which this period begins.

temperature.name: Setpoint
temperature.description: Values below 8 °C disable heating or cooling for this period.

enabled_zones.name: Enabled zones
enabled_zones.description: Optional zone states for a single-set-point schedule. Omit this field to preserve the existing zone states; it is not used for MTSP zones.
